title: 第2章 王麻子拦路起歹念，周小卒斗智夺干粮
slug: 边军从领取罪女开始一统天下
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王麻子这两天心情很不好。

他本来想趁着这次发营妻的机会，给自己换个年轻点的。

结果刚刚选中一个寡妇走到半路，被上面总旗大人的亲戚截胡了。

一肚子邪火憋在裤裆里，正愁没处撒，正好看到周起扛着女人要走。

周起这小子平时闷不作声，也就是个凑数的新兵蛋子，最好欺负。

随着周起的步伐颠簸，裙摆往上缩了一截。

那一截雪白小腿露了出来，白嫩白嫩的，像是剥了壳的鸡蛋，嫩得在日头底下反光。

而且那女人虽然瘦，但这会儿离近了一看，脸蛋虽然脏，可那五官是真的精致。

是个尤物。

洗干净了，指不定多润。

王麻子心里那股火又窜上来了。

“伍长有事？”

周起停下脚步，侧过身。

女人还挂在他肩膀上，脑袋朝下，正好看到王麻子那双满是泥垢的靴子。

“周起，懂不懂规矩？”

王麻子背着手，歪着脑袋，三角眼在女人曲线玲珑的臀线上扫了一圈，咽了口唾沫。

“好货色得先紧着长官，这道理还要我教你？”

周围的兵油子们都不笑了，一个个抱着膀子看戏。

军营里，伍长抢手下兵的东西，天经地义。

谁拳头大谁有理。

大家心里都明白，漂亮的领回去养活了，也会被上官盯上，早晚给自己戴绿帽。

周起要是识相，这时候就该把人放下，还得赔着笑脸说几句好话。

“那依伍长您的意思呢？”

周起没动，语气平平淡淡，听不出喜怒。

王麻子嘿嘿一笑，指了指旁边地上坐着的一个傻大姐。

“那个壮实，抗造，赏你了。至于你肩上这个……太瘦，怕你养不活，哥帮你养几天，养润了再给你玩。”

说着，王麻子伸手就要去抓女人大腿内侧最嫩的软肉。

女人吓得浑身一缩，死死抓着周起后背。

周起突然侧跨了一步，身子微微一横，右手顺势迎了上去。

“啪！”

一声脆响，两人的手掌在半空中结结实实地撞个正着，活像是两个交情极好的袍泽在击掌庆贺。

王麻子被这突如其来的一巴掌拍得手心发麻，整个人都愣在了原地。

“伍长真是太客气了！”

周起脸上堆起热情的笑，握住王麻子的手用力摇了摇，“伍长这份体恤下属的情分，兄弟心领了！”

这一握王麻子吃痛之下，下意识得想往回抽出手，但是竟然拉不到。

周围看戏的兵油子们也是一愣。

这还是那个唯唯诺诺的周起吗？

周起没有给王麻子反应时间。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Mazi has been in a bad mood these past two days.

He originally wanted to take advantage of this opportunity to find a new wife and give himself a younger one.

As a result, a widow who had just been selected was intercepted halfway by a relative of the chief banner officer above.

A stomach full of evil fire was simmering in his crotch, and he was just worried that he had nowhere to vent his worries, when he saw Zhou Qi carrying a woman and leaving.

This kid Zhou Qi is usually silent, he is just a recruit who just makes up the numbers, and is best bullied.

As Zhou Qi's steps bumped, the hem of her skirt shrank upwards.

The snow-white calf was exposed, white and tender, like a peeled egg, so tender that it reflected light under the sun.

And although the woman was thin, when she got closer, she saw that although her face was dirty, her facial features were really exquisite.

What a stunner.

After washing it, it may look moisturized.

The fire in Wang Mazi's heart surged up again.

"Is there something wrong, Captain?"

Zhou Qi stopped and turned sideways.

The woman was still hanging on his shoulders, with her head facing down, just in time to see Wang Mazi's muddy boots.

"Zhou Qi, do you understand the rules?"

Wang Mazi put his hands behind his back, tilted his head, his triangular eyes swept around the woman's curvy hip line, and swallowed.

"A good thing must first stick to your command, sir. Do you want me to teach you this?"

The soldiers around them all stopped laughing and watched the show with their arms folded.

In the military camp, it is only natural that the corps commander grabs the things belonging to the soldiers.

Whoever has the bigger fist is right.

Everyone knows in their hearts that if a beautiful girl is taken back to support her, she will be targeted by the superior and sooner or later she will be cuckolded.

If Zhou Qi had known the truth, he would have put the person down at this time and said a few nice words with a smile on his face.

"What do you mean, Commander Yi?"

Zhou Qi didn't move, his tone was calm, and there was no hint of emotion or anger.

Wang Mazi chuckled and pointed at a silly lady sitting on the ground next to him.

"The one on your shoulder is strong and resistant. As for the one on your shoulder... it's too thin. I'm afraid you won't be able to keep it alive. I'll help you raise it for a few days. Once it's moisturized, I'll let you play with it."

As he said that, Wang Mazi stretched out his hand to grab the tenderest soft flesh on the inner side of the woman's thigh.

The woman shrank in fear and clutched Zhou Qi's back.

Zhou Qi suddenly took a step sideways, turned his body slightly, and moved his right hand forward to meet him.

"Crack!"

There was a crisp sound, and the palms of the two people collided firmly in mid-air, as if two people who had a close relationship were high-fiving each other in celebration.

Wang Mazi was stunned by this sudden slap, which made his palms numb and his whole body froze on the spot.

"Captain Wu is so kind!"

A warm smile appeared on Zhou Qi's face, he took Wang Mazi's hand and shook it vigorously, "Brothers appreciate the corporal's compassion for his subordinates!"

Wang Mazi felt the pain from this grip and subconsciously wanted to pull his hand back, but he couldn't.

The soldiers watching the show were also stunned.

Is this still the submissive Zhou Qi?

Zhou Qi didn't give Wang Mazi time to react.
